description: This is a shell script (`generate_rag_report.sh`) that generates a RAG status report for HAL interface components by parsing metadata.yaml files across different components. It aggregates component statuses, review progress, and outputs a markdown report summarizing interface readiness, review statuses, and team coverage.

methods.name: yaml_val
methods.description: Extracts a top-level value from a YAML file based on a specified key.

methods.name: yaml_nested
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from a YAML file given a parent and child key.

methods.name: yaml_review_progress
methods.description: Calculates review progress as a ratio from the reviewers section of a YAML file.

methods.name: yaml_reviewer_status
methods.description: Gets the review status for a specific reviewer team from a YAML file.

methods.name: review_icon
methods.description: Maps review status strings to corresponding emoji icons.

methods.name: component_path
methods.description: Derives the component's relative path label from its metadata.yaml location.

methods.name: rag_icon
methods.description: Maps RAG status (GREEN, AMBER, RED) to corresponding emoji indicators.
